A1.justification: Both complete PDFs describe the same arithmetic-generalization framework and experiments. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices support reliable comparison despite substantial reorganization.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C report original GPT training curves, digit-level analyses, and arithmetic test accuracies.

after.justification: Section 4 and Appendix H retain the work's original training results, learning-dynamics analyses, and arithmetic test accuracies.

M1.justification: The same decoder-only NanoGPT, MicroGPT, and MiniGPT framework remains. The revised carry equations change the theoretical analysis; v2 does not document an algorithmic or architectural revision.

E1.justification: Both versions cover addition, multiplication, modular addition, and modular multiplication with the same operand-length domains and modulus sets. Renaming inward/outward generalization to downward/upward does not change the tested scenarios.

E2.justification: The model-scale comparisons and positional-embedding evidence retain the same methods. The reproduced McLeish et al. abacus results and cited Jelassi et al. findings remain; no comparator is newly evaluated or removed.

E3.justification: The reported model configurations, optimizer settings, reversed outputs, zero-padding, maximum-probability decoding, and test sampling remain unchanged. V2's dataset-count and mixture tables add documentation of existing experiments without establishing a changed protocol.

E4.justification: The model/data-scale checks, digit-wise learning curves, decision-tree R2 analysis, and digit-correlation analysis are retained. Moving the learning-dynamics analysis into Appendix H and adding an undertraining explanation do not introduce new experimental analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. V2's carry-failure probability is an analytical claim under T1, rather than empirical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: All corresponding numerical result rows match, and the plotted results are retained. For example, nine-digit modular addition with p=50 remains at 91.4% accuracy in v1 Table 3 and v2 Table 4.

T1.justification: V2 replaces v1's adjacent-digit addition formula with recursive carry propagation. Theorem 3 replaces perfect upward generalization with a stated failure bound below 1/10^(n-1), supported by a revised long-carry argument in Appendix B.2. The theorem statements also replace sufficient computation with infinite computation and are labeled informal.

C1.justification: The unified-framework contribution remains, but v2 focuses the framing on arithmetic length generalization and qualifies the RPE generalization claim. It removes v1's separate contribution about redirecting AI research and adds a claim of being first to address task differences in arithmetic generalization.

C2.justification: V2 adds explicit convergence, length-generalization, and complex-task limitations in Section 7. Table 12 newly attributes the retained p=150/200 modular-multiplication discrepancies to undertraining. It also identifies long-carry failure cases and removes v1's satori/emergence interpretation.

D1.justification: V2 adds training-data counts and mixture descriptions in Tables 3 and 6, MIT licensing information, and minGPT source provenance. Existing hyperparameters are relocated unchanged, while v1's RTX 4090 hardware disclosure and explicit cross-entropy description disappear.

R1.justification: V2 adds explicit task-difference novelty positioning and removes several references, including the GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Shaw, Su, and Wennberg–Henter works. The principal arithmetic-generalization and universal-approximation literature remains.

P1.justification: The abstract, introduction, discussion, and conclusion are extensively rewritten, and inward/outward terminology becomes downward/upward. Proofs, remarks, multiplication analysis, and learning-dynamics discussion move into reorganized appendices, with new limitations and documentation sections.

P2.justification: V2 adopts a two-column main text, rearranges Figure 1 from three-by-two to two-by-three panels, and merges Table 1's modular-operation columns. Figures and tables are extensively resized and relocated, including v1 Figure 2 becoming v2 Figure 5 and v1 Table 4 becoming v2 Table 9. Dataset and model-scale tables are added.

improvement.justification: The carry correction, qualified RPE claim, explicit convergence limitations, and explanation of undertrained results improve scientific precision. Dataset and licensing disclosures also help reproducibility, although the GPU disclosure is lost. The improvement remains limited: Section 4.3 still describes modular-addition accuracy as perfect despite the retained sub-100% results in Table 4.
